test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20d3958debad8c6cd5204ca2598f7b7268e3e03195f2811f8961391e0e3795fb.png] Logic followed here is: The first letter of the first cluster is increased by 4 to get the first letter of the second cluster, and the second letter of the first cluster is increased by 6 to get the second letter of the second cluster. 1) MG – QM [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711b4c296a097368013b7fe909fd2cbcaf0f5c60c8b1076541cbc676c5cae545.png] 2) YJ – CP
